name: Saints Michael, Gabriel and Raphael
history: The three angels named in Scripture. Michael, whose name asks who is like God, leads the heavenly host against Satan. Gabriel, the strength of God, brought Mary the news of the Incarnation. Raphael, God heals, guided Tobias and cured his father’s blindness. In England the day has long been kept as Michaelmas, a quarter day and the start of the autumn term.
life: The Church teaches that the angels are real, spiritual creatures who serve God and watch over us. Scripture names three. Michael appears in Daniel as the great prince who stands guard over God’s people, in the Letter of Jude disputing with the devil, and in the Apocalypse casting the dragon out of heaven. Gabriel is sent to Daniel to explain his visions, to Zechariah in the Temple to announce the birth of John the Baptist, and to Nazareth to greet Mary. Raphael, in the Book of Tobit, travels in disguise with the young Tobias, protects him and heals his father, then reveals himself as one of the seven who stand before the Lord. The date recalls the dedication of a basilica of Saint Michael on the Via Salaria near Rome in the early centuries. Since 1970 the three archangels have shared one feast.
prayer: Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle. Be our protection against the wickedness and snares of the devil. May God rebuke him, we humbly pray; and do thou, O Prince of the heavenly host, by the power of God, thrust into hell Satan and all the evil spirits who wander through the world for the ruin of souls. Amen.
prayerTo: Saint Michael, defend us in the battle against evil. Saint Gabriel, help us to hear the word of God and answer it as Mary did. Saint Raphael, guide us on our journeys and bring healing to the sick. Holy archangels, and my own guardian angel, keep me close to God this day and all the days of my life. Amen.
penance: Pray the Saint Michael prayer today, and do a kindness for someone who is travelling or sick.
meditation: Michael’s name is a question: who is like God? Is there anything in your life that you have set up as though it were God?
